fields.text: Still from a prompt, then MiniMax H3 Spicy (open-weights i2v) animates it — expressive motion, optional last frame, 480p, ~5s. First-click is a red silk dress on a rainy Tokyo fire escape; swap the still or the move. Spicy model, SFW fashion scene.

a woman in a wind-whipped red silk dress on a rainy neon Tokyo fire escape at night, wet metal stairs, magenta and teal signs blooming in puddles, fashion editorial, three-quarter view, face turned away, cinematic 35mm, shallow depth, no logos, no readable text

fields.prompt: silk dress snaps and billows in the rain wind, she turns half a step down the fire escape, camera slow orbit right, neon reflections crawl across wet metal, rain streaks

fields.text:
You are writing a motion prompt for MiniMax H3 Spicy image-to-video.
Prompting guide:
1. Be specific. Name subjects, spatial layout, style, and actions clearly.
2. Direct the scene — left vs right, foreground vs background, facing toward vs away.
3. Describe texture and material: fabric, hair, wet metal, neon glow, rain.
4. For image-to-video, use verbs. Specify who moves, what moves, how they move, and what the camera does.
5. Avoid static, photo-like prompts.
6. Keep motion readable in a short clip (~5s): one clear camera move and one or two subject actions.
7. Stay SFW fashion/cinematic even on the Spicy model — no explicit content.

Reply with the motion prompt only. No preamble.
the red silk snaps sideways in a wet gust, she takes one careful step down the fire escape, camera slow orbit right as neon crawls over the puddles
